how: We read the website of every Boston wedding videographer listed on Lazo (150 listings, 111 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photographers and DJs listed as videographers, a photo booth company, an audio-visual rental firm, and sites with nothing specific about their own wedding films. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you record the vows and toasts: lapel mics and a feed from the DJ board, or just the camera?
What is the turnaround on the highlight film and the full edit, and are the raw files included?
Fall weddings here lose light early. How do you handle a 4:30 sunset and a dark reception room?

picks.name: Precious Moments Wedding Films
picks.blurb: Precious Moments Wedding Films has made cinematic-style wedding films for more than 30 years with a discreet, unobtrusive approach. Owner and creative director Amanda Yazinka, a Plymouth State graduate, has spent 14 years as a cinematographer and editor and works throughout New England from Hudson.

picks.name: Hanscoop Films
picks.blurb: Brian of Hanscoop Films makes documentary wedding films in Boston and says his job is to notice things, the breath before a toast or the guest who laughs a second early. He stays out of the way for most of the day. Collections begin at $4,400, and the site lists The Knot Best of Weddings 2025.

picks.name: Adam Gorham Films
picks.blurb: Adam Gorham spent years filming for national wedding companies before founding his own boutique studio in Shrewsbury to take a more intentional, artful approach. He has filmed hundreds of weddings across New England and works Boston, New York City, Florida and destinations.

picks.name: New England Wedding Film
picks.blurb: A Worcester studio shooting cinematic, colorful, modern wedding films and photographs since 2016, led by a filmmaker with a Netflix credit. New England Wedding Film has documented more than 200 weddings across the region and abroad for couples who want both photo and video from one team.

picks.name: EZV PRODUCTIONS, LLC
picks.blurb: EZV Productions started in 2013 as a husband-and-wife team wanting films that felt the way their own wedding film should, and has grown into a company of videographers, editors and creators in Braintree. One wedding, three ways to remember it: cinematic, documentary and candid, with content creation offered too.

picks.name: Lovely Valentine Photography + Film
picks.blurb: Lovely Valentine pairs editorial photography with wedding films from the same Somerville studio, led by photographer and filmmaker Emilie Pickering. Honesty and emotion are the core of the work, which covers Boston, Newport, New England and international destinations.

picks.name: A Perfect Image Photography and Video Studio
picks.blurb: A Perfect Image in Danvers has provided wedding photography and video together since 1987, a medium-sized studio with several photographers and videographers so there is backup personnel. The site prints that its most popular photo and video packages range from $1,500 to $2,000, and lists awards from The Knot and WeddingWire.

picks.name: HBZ Media
picks.blurb: HBZ Media is Zach Johnson's independently owned video company in Watertown, specializing in wedding and brand films with over a decade of experience. The site describes Zach as the easiest person to talk to and work with, and his approach as purpose-driven storytelling.

picks.name: Dwayne Julius Videography
picks.blurb: Dwayne Julius says he translates weddings rather than documents them, with luxury cinematic films for couples who believe their story is worth telling. Options start with a single, carefully crafted highlight film, he takes a limited number of weddings a year, and he is based in Rhode Island with travel fees outside New England.

picks.name: PTaufiq Photography
picks.blurb: PTaufiq Photography offers luxury wedding photography and cinematography anywhere in the world from a base in Dracut, with a staff of 20 photographers and videographers in the United States and 14 in India. The studio has documented hundreds of weddings worldwide.
